masks: masks/<photo>.png (255 car, 0 not, 128 ignore); r13, r16, r17 corrected by hand with the polygons of masks/fix.json (white = car: r16 bumper bottom and left corner, r17 bumper bottom, r13 tail lamp tip; grey = ignore: r17 tailpipe)
cams: fit/cams.json (cameras + body pose per photo, solved together with the lattice)
anchors: fit/anchors_rims.json (wheel rim anchors on r02, r10, r13)

lattice.note: the largest control point moves (up to 0.20 m) are at the empty outer corners above the bonnet (|x| 1.33, y >= 1.45, z >= 1.75); rms 0.05
